name: Protect Instruction 5
definition: Provides detailed information on protect and cover protect instructions.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Indicates whether the instruction is a protect or a cover protect instruction.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique reference of the protect transaction assigned by the depository and used for cover protect validation.

ProtectSafekeepingAccount.name: Protect Safekeeping Account
ProtectSafekeepingAccount.definition: Account which submitted the original protect instruction used for cover protect instructions whereby one safekeeping account is covering on behalf of another safekeeping account.

ProtectDate.name: Protect Date
ProtectDate.definition: Date at which the protect instruction was created and used for cover protect validation.
